game_concept: A racing platformer set in Frost Peaks – Icefall Ladder, ladders up an icefall: the avalanche scout must handle crevasse ghouls while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – F-String Herald: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements.
theme: Frost Peaks – Icefall Ladder: ladders up an icefall
core_gameplay_loop: In Icefall Ladder, repeat each round: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the avalanche scout ahead. Then check the announcements value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the flag pole by solving code steps involving announcements that move the avalanche scout forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the flag pole first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 10 (extended tier): F-String Herald
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'F-String Herald' (Week 8 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Icefall Ladder'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how announcements changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crevasse ghouls in Icefall Ladder.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
